subject: Computation time and memory requirements for rsf

messages.author: 59f1ce7fb04e1e5b
messages.subject: Computation time and memory requirements for rsf
parts:
Hi Chris,
Is it possible to run resource selection functions on much larger extents, say for areas over 1000 km²? I am working with migratory birds, and my research question would require me to consider large areas.
Regards,
Tejas

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Computation time and memory requirements for rsf
parts:
Hi Tejas,

It's possible, but slow to use larger extents. Regular, location-based RSFs are not appropriate for migration behaviors, though, and would only apply to the summer and winter ranges separately. SSFs can be validly used on migration and dispersal tracks, to look at selection along the route.

Best,
Chris
